outreach_drafts.subject: Maria, thank you for showing up for Miami
outreach_drafts.body:
Dear Maria,

Thank you for giving through Give Miami Day in 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025. Your steady generosity is a meaningful part of this local tradition, and we’re grateful to have you alongside us.

Here’s what we did recently: The Miami Foundation partnered with McDermott Will & Schulte to provide pro bono legal counsel to 17 Miami nonprofits, resulting in 398 hours of service valued at more than $500,000. We’re proud to share this example of bringing partners together in service of Miami’s nonprofit community.

As November brings us back to a celebration you’ve supported year after year, we have one invitation: please make a Give Miami Day gift at givemiamiday.org when early giving opens Saturday, November 14, 2026.

Everyone has a role to play. Thank you for the role you’ve chosen in Miami’s story.

With gratitude,
The Miami Foundation’s Philanthropy Team
outreach_drafts.call_script:
Opener: Hi Maria, this is [staff member] with The Miami Foundation’s philanthropy team. Thank you for giving through Give Miami Day in 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025. We’re grateful for your steady support.

Update: Here’s what we did recently: The Miami Foundation partnered with McDermott Will & Schulte to provide pro bono legal counsel to 17 Miami nonprofits, resulting in 398 hours of service valued at more than $500,000.

Ask: Would you make a Give Miami Day gift at givemiamiday.org when early giving opens Saturday, November 14, 2026?

If Maria says “not this year”: Of course, Maria—thank you for all you’ve already given and for being part of Miami’s community.

outreach_drafts.subject: Luis, a Miami update ahead of Give Miami Day
outreach_drafts.body:
Dear Luis,

Thank you for your online giving each December from 2022 through 2025, including your $1,200 gift on December 15, 2025. We’re grateful for your steady generosity toward Miami.

Here’s what we’ve been working on recently: The Jorge M. Pérez Family Foundation at The Miami Foundation announced a $720,000 investment in Miami-Dade County’s nonprofit arts sector through its CreARTE grant program. Also, the Miami Disaster Resilience Fund is investing $135,000 in resilience hubs and community-based organizations strengthening preparedness across Miami-Dade County.

From the arts to community preparedness, these updates reflect work happening close to home. Everyone has a role to play, and we’re glad you’re part of Miami’s philanthropic community.

Would you make a Give Miami Day gift at givemiamiday.org when early giving opens Saturday, November 14, 2026?

Thank you for considering it, Luis. Miami, this is your celebration.

Warmly,
The Miami Foundation’s Philanthropy Team

outreach_drafts.subject: McDermott Will & Schulte: let’s connect before Give Miami Day
outreach_drafts.body:
To the McDermott Will & Schulte team,

Thank you for your partnership and support of The Miami Foundation. We’re grateful to work alongside you for Miami.

Here’s what we did together: The Miami Foundation partnered with McDermott Will & Schulte to provide pro bono legal counsel to 17 Miami nonprofits, resulting in 398 hours of service valued at more than $500,000.

That partnership is something to celebrate—a way to put your team’s expertise to work for local nonprofits. Everyone has a role to play, and we appreciate yours.

With Give Miami Day approaching, would you be open to a call or coffee with our philanthropy team about your year-end giving? We’d welcome a personal conversation about what matters most to your team and where you’d like to focus.

Warmly,
The Miami Foundation’s Philanthropy Team

outreach_drafts.subject: A year-end conversation as Give Miami Day approaches
outreach_drafts.body:
Dear Frederick A. DeLuca Foundation team,

Thank you for your partnership and support of The Miami Foundation. We’re grateful to have you alongside us in our work for Miami.

Here’s a recent update: The Jorge M. Pérez Family Foundation at The Miami Foundation announced a $720,000 investment in Miami-Dade County’s nonprofit arts sector through its CreARTE grant program.

We also commissioned and unveiled South Dade Community Needs and Nonprofit Funding Landscape, which analyzed more than 1,400 grants to 262 South Dade nonprofits and included interviews with 19 community leaders, providers and advocates.

With Give Miami Day approaching, would you join our philanthropy team for a call or coffee about your year-end giving? We’d welcome the chance to listen to your priorities and explore where your interests and Miami’s needs meet. Everyone has a role to play, and we value your perspective.

Warmly,
The Miami Foundation’s Philanthropy Team

outreach_drafts.subject: Thank you for your partnership in Miami
outreach_drafts.body:
Dear Biscayne Harbor Family Foundation,

Thank you for your partnership and support of The Miami Foundation. We’re grateful to share a commitment to Miami with you.

Here’s what we did recently: we commissioned and unveiled South Dade Community Needs and Nonprofit Funding Landscape, which analyzed more than 1,400 grants to 262 South Dade nonprofits and included interviews with 19 community leaders, providers and advocates.

Inspired directly by that report, Amazon announced a $1 million investment in 13 South Dade nonprofit organizations to strengthen their capacity and deepen their community impact. We’re pleased to share this connection between local research and support for South Dade nonprofits.

With Give Miami Day approaching, would you be open to a call or coffee with our philanthropy team about your year-end giving? We’d welcome the chance to hear what matters most to you.

Warmly,
The Miami Foundation Philanthropy Team
outreach_drafts.call_script:

UPDATE: Here’s what we did recently: we commissioned and unveiled South Dade Community Needs and Nonprofit Funding Landscape. It analyzed more than 1,400 grants to 262 South Dade nonprofits and included interviews with 19 community leaders, providers and advocates. Inspired directly by that report, Amazon announced a $1 million investment in 13 South Dade nonprofit organizations to strengthen their capacity and deepen their community impact.

ASK: With Give Miami Day approaching, would you be open to a call or coffee with our philanthropy team about your year-end giving?

IF NOT THIS YEAR: Of course—we understand, and we appreciate your partnership and support.
